# Weapon (`magic-items:weapon`)
**Category:** [Weapons](../equipment-categories/weapons.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon (+1), Rare (+2), or Very Rare (+3) | **Attunement:** No
**Variants:** [Weapon +1](../magic-items/weapon-1.md), [Weapon +2](../magic-items/weapon-2.md), [Weapon +3](../magic-items/weapon-3.md)

Weapon (Any Simple or Martial)

You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity.
